description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing containerized processes within the WPEFramework project, specifically implementing the CRunContainer class and its administrator. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to container management.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via the CRUN runtime, providing methods to start, stop, and query container status.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing multiple CRunContainer instances, providing container creation and logging functionalities.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with the specified command and parameters.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, with a specified timeout.

methods.name: CRunContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on the provided ID and search paths.

methods.name: CRunContainerAdministrator::Logging
methods.description: Configures logging options for container management.
